title: ilex godajam var. capitellata
intro: Ilex godajam var. capitellata, commonly known as the "Nilgiri holly," is a plant species that belongs to the Aquifoliaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The Nilgiri holly is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, such as aucubin, ursolic acid, and oleanolic acid.
